KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. nene
   C. fupi
   D. zito

2. When practising Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.

3. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. kitoto
   D. watoto

4. When practising Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.

5. When practising Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.

6. When practising Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida.

7. When practising Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.

8. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

9. When practising Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.

10. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.

11. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania.

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kuandika 7.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Sarufi 7.4.1 Vitenzi Vishirikishi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
